dedupe_keys.name: futurestreams discharge and water temperature scripts

description: The FutureStreams GitHub repository provides scripts used in preparing global discharge and water-temperature scenarios. Its README identifies routines for derived ecological variables, masks for unrealistic pixels and processing of weekly flow and temperature output from PCR-GLOBWB and DynWat. A water-infrastructure modeller can inspect the transformations when constructing comparable river-temperature or inflow indicators for a scenario study. These scripts are not the underlying hydrological and temperature models, and their outputs depend on external climate and model runs. GitHub reports GPL-3.0. I read repository metadata and README without cloning, executing code or obtaining the large published scenario dataset. The associated Yoda data landing was bot-protected during this review and is not treated as verified. No exact catalogue software record was found. The related Yoda FutureStreams data deposit was identified by DOI but its current file access could not be checked through the protected landing page.
